description: Record one decision (a choice and why), change, problem, learning or todo. Call it right after each decision, change, fix or lesson, and before you end or hand back. To update todos or problems: manage_todos / manage_problems. Only adds. Review mode or suggested=true may queue it. A shared-component change alerts linked projects. A close decision gets a possible-conflict note; act on it. conflicts_with opens a disagreement card. Secrets are refused. Returns {logged, record, note} or {queued_for_review}.

category.description: learning only: the kind of lesson.

component.description: Component name; created if missing. Shared ones too.

details.description: Why, or old and new values. Max 10,000 chars.

evidence.description: Up to 2: file:line, or output:/url:/tool: text.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

suggested.description: true = queue it for the user's review.

summary.description: The record in one short line.

name: log_work
